name: EditorialSectionHead

props.description: Id on the title, for the section's aria-labelledby.
props.name: titleId

tagline: A section's head (gh#1435): kicker, an editorial h2, one line of description and a trailing action on the title's row — usually an `EditorialTextLink` "view all →" (an inline-flex link with a trailing arrow, `asChild` for a router link). Geometry: `--editorial-section-head-*`, `--editorial-text-link-*`.
